content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler interface artifact for init_gpu, generated from init_gpu.f90. It records CUDA stream and device-memory initialization and destruction, allocation of model and wavemaker GPU variables, imported accelerator/runtime APIs and FUNWAVE modules, and opaque compiler metadata tables (lines 1-951).
entities: init_gpu compiler-interface artifact generated from init_gpu.f90 (lines 1-2)

Dependencies on iso_c_binding, cuSPARSE, param, global, sort, nvf_acc_common, cuTENSOR, GPU reduction, CUDA runtime, cudafor_la, mod_cuda, boundary_condition_module, and dispersionfluxessources (lines 4-19)
cudamemuse interface for reporting CUDA memory use (lines 270-278)
stream_init and stream_destroy interfaces for CUDA stream lifecycle (lines 279-294)
allocate_variables_gpu interface for device-side model allocation (lines 295-310)
allocate_wavemaker_variables_gpu interface for wavemaker device allocation (lines 326-339)
Opaque compiler declarations, attributes, array descriptors, cross-references, argument maps, and type records (lines 20-269, 340-951)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 compiler module format and the meanings of its D/S/R/A/F/J/V/T/X/Z numeric records, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact, so most numeric metadata cannot be decoded from the file alone (lines 1, 20-951).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).
